newsitem.title: UK: BRITISH GAMBLER LANDS FORTUNE WITH $16 BET.
newsitem.headline: BRITISH GAMBLER LANDS FORTUNE WITH $16 BET.

text.p: A gambler won almost 300,000 pounds ($485,000) with a 10 pounds ($16) stake by correctly predicting the results of 13 British soccer matches, a bookmaker said on Tuesday.

The mystery punter could be forgiven for sending a case of champagne to Danish striker Soren Andersen, who scored in the last minute of the final game on Monday night to round off an astonishing feat of forecasting.
A spokesman for bookmaker Ladbrokes, which took the bet, said it was the largest number of correct results he could ever recall anyone predicting.
"He must have chewed his nails to the knuckles but so did we, and we honestly wished him well," said Ian Wassell.
"Believe it or not bookmakers share the excitement of these once-in-a-blue-moon bets. He studied the form and it paid off."
Staff at the Ladbrokes shope in the southern English town of Bournemouth, where the bet was placed, said no one had yet claimed the money.
